description: An extensible Markdown engine is wrapped by a slide-extension hook that activates slide rendering only when the document begins with a front-matter block carrying the opt-in directive. Activation is observable through wire-format markers in the produced HTML: a slide container element, an injected style element, and inline slide-renderer output. These boundary scenarios exercise the activation decision across an empty source, an explicit opt-out directive, a front-matter block that carries unrelated keys but no opt-in directive, an opted-in block that additionally carries unrelated keys, and a source whose leading line is not the front-matter fence. The input supplies the raw Markdown source and the markers to probe; each probed marker is reported as present or absent.

input.markdown:
---
marp: true
theme: default
paginate: true
---
